components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary command for running research actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #0F7B8A; color: #fff; padding: 10px 14px; font: 700 14px/1.2 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0B6470; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(72,191,210,.28); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary command that does not compete with the main run action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #2B3844; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #48BFD2; padding: 9px 12px; font: 700 14px/1.2 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #48BFD2; background: rgba(72,191,210,.09); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(72,191,210,.28); }

components.name: Research Input
components.description: Compact field for codes, prompts, and numeric criteria.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #9BAAB7; font: 700 12px/1.3 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #2B3844; border-radius: 4px; background: #151B22; color: #F2F7FA; padding: 10px 12px; font: 500 13px/1.35 Fira Code, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #48BFD2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(72,191,210,.22); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Persistent workbench destination with icon, label, and compact hint.
components.html: 筛筛选基础 / 概念 / 趋势
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 8px 10px; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: #9BAAB7; padding: 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item span { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #2B3844; border-radius: 6px; color: #48BFD2; } .ds-nav-item strong { color: #F2F7FA; font: 700 14px/1.2 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item em { grid-column: 2; color: #9BAAB7; font: 500 12px/1.2 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-style: normal; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: rgba(72,191,210,.35); background: rgba(72,191,210,.09); }

components.css: .ds-result-panel { border: 1px solid #2B3844; border-radius: 8px; background: #151B22; color: #F2F7FA; padding: 16px; } .ds-result-panel header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-result-panel span { color: #9BAAB7; font: 700 12px/1.3 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-result-panel strong { font: 600 13px/1.35 Fira Code, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-result-panel p { margin: 0; color: #C8D3DC; font: 400 14px/1.55 Fira Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like a focused research desk: quiet, structured, and built around evidence. It uses a restrained dark-first workbench, strong text contrast, compact controls, and a single cyan action color so data and status remain louder than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Dense product UI with stable navigation, filters, result panels, and evidence blocks.
Dark-first palette with a light mode equivalent, semantic rise/fall/warning colors, and no decorative gradients.
4px to 10px radii, thin borders, tonal layering, and shadows only for sticky or elevated overlays.
Single sans family for UI, monospace only for codes, values, timestamps, and tabular data.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Cyan is reserved for action, selection, focus, and progress. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Market Rule
rules.body: Red and green only describe market direction or positive/negative evidence, and must be paired with text.

rules.name: The No Display Labels Rule
rules.body: UI labels, buttons, and data never use display styling. Large type is for orientation, not routine controls.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Routine modules do not use decorative shadow. Use border, tone, and spacing first.

dos: Do keep the current conditions and data source visible near the working surface.
Do use cyan only for action, selection, focus, and progress.
Do pair red/green market colors with text labels, arrows, or context.
Do keep controls at 44px minimum touch target on mobile.
Do preserve reduced-motion support and use motion only for state changes.
donts: Don't build marketing-style hero sections, decorative metric strips, or sales copy.
Don't use purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, glowing blobs, or ornamental background effects.
Don't use thick side-stripe borders on cards or alerts.
Don't rely on red/green alone to convey meaning.
Don't write investment-advice language such as “必涨”, “稳赢”, “立即买入”, “目标价”, or “满仓”.
